title: Excel #SPILL! Error? Check the Cells in Its Way #Shorts
description:
Excel #SPILL! error? A blocked destination cell may be the cause. See how to locate the obstructing cell before deleting or moving data.

Original diagrams and synthetic English narration; not a real account or software screen capture. Official source: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/how-to-correct-a-spill-error #FlowMinuteLab #TechTips

scenes.title: ONE CELL BLOCKS IT
scenes.narration: Your Excel formula returns a spill error. Often the cells where its results should appear are not empty.

scenes.title: SEE THE RANGE
scenes.narration: Select the formula cell. Excel can show the intended spill range with a dashed border.

scenes.title: FIND OBSTRUCTION
scenes.narration: Excel's error alert may offer Select Obstructing Cells. Use it to locate values blocking the output.

scenes.title: FIX SAFELY
scenes.narration: Review what is in those cells. Move unrelated data safely before clearing anything; then let the formula recalculate.

scenes.title: NOT EVERY SPILL
scenes.narration: Blocked ranges are one common cause, not the only one. Read the exact error explanation before deleting data.
